title: ID0475790-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117066] DC_Coils_MG1-MG4_SelfTest
description:
Reported Issue/ Behavior:
While a charging session is active on Outlet 1, Outlet 2 goes into “Out of Service” status. Similarly, when a charging session is active on Outlet 2, Outlet 1 goes into “Out of Service” status.
During our investigation, we observed the following PLC error flags:
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10' initial value true - (contactor stuck at ON feedback)
LOG FILES AND PICTURES ARE ATTACHED AND CAN BE FOUND IN THE ATTACHMENT SECTION
We kindly request that you conduct a detailed investigation and let us know exactly what the problem is.
Worked by Felipe Moraes
